name: 司南

governance.execution_rule: Core Sinan Agent uses these tools under actual host mandates; tools neither instantiate Agents nor grant authority
governance.delegation_rule: Any later delegation or agent creation follows the shared organization and admission rules
governance.revocation: Host revokes affected mandates and disables module invocation; preserve source records and label history

inputs.command_preparation: source alias, supported source operation and argument array
inputs.authority: actual host mandate and filesystem permissions
inputs.document_sync: Optional registry-relative write_root and registered documents with tickets/parent_tickets and unique sinan markers
inputs.issue_tracking: Optional {enabled:boolean,provider:git-issue,authority_ref}; absence or enabled:false means source-work-item handoff, not external Issue creation

outputs.board: items, sourceSnapshots, diagnostics, ready keys and proposed source-work-item followUps; Git Issue actions only with explicit issue_tracking binding
outputs.labels: audited local coordination updates; no source status mutation
outputs.handoff: executable and argv with fresh-check requirements; execution=not_executed
outputs.progress_document: source-derived states, labels, owners, blockers, acceptance and snapshot versions
outputs.sync_result: Per-document results and repair followUps; outcome=partial for isolated document errors; never remote closure or execution receipts

dependencies.external_replacement: Adapters must preserve source identity, evidence, authority and dependency semantics; direct external connectors are not implemented

write: coordination labels and label_history in the designated registry
derived progress.md beside the designated registry; source state remains authoritative
Explicitly registered document marker regions within canonical document_sync.write_root
access.budget: Bound by current host mandate; no standing spend or execution budget

runtime.environment: Node.js with local filesystem; verified on Node 24 Windows
runtime.current_adapter: existing local Yuanheng ledger and CLI
runtime.coverage: registered sources only; empty by default; no global event listener
runtime.compatibility: Document read/marker/write failures return partial instead of throwing; callers must inspect outcome and updated. Unsafe configuration and protected output violations still throw. pending_user is advisory; explicit pending_user_blocking limits affected transitions. Default Issue actions are now null; hosts requiring Git must explicitly bind issue_tracking and continue to authenticate operations. Existing issue_ref is historical linkage, not activation.
runtime.host: current authorized host, invoked by actual task events

concurrency.conflicts: write/write and read/write by canonical path; read/read allowed

runtime.reporting: Required shared skill reporting; actual host binding and delivered receipt are mandatory for observed business execution; refresh output is not a receipt.

cancel_and_resume.reads: Stop and regenerate from fresh source snapshots
cancel_and_resume.labels: Use the shared registry lock and atomic replace; restore classification through audited label changes; after interruption verify no live writer before recovering a stale lock
cancel_and_resume.source_work: Cancellation and recovery are delegated to source-supported operations and host mandates; unsupported transitions are not simulated

acceptance: resolve registered entry and runtime bindings
differentiate definition admission from production deployment

implementation_source.reuse: Coordinator derived from original; explicit nonblocking decision and follow-up changes in 0.4.2; no historical bindings imported
